risks.title: Foreign Exchange Fluctuations
risks.score_rationale: The risk is disclosed in Item 1A with high intensity. Operations outside the United States represent approximately 91% of total sales in 2025. Significant currency exposures include the Japanese yen, euro, and Swiss franc. A stronger U.S. dollar may reduce consolidated sales reported in U.S. dollars.

risks.title: Dependence on China
risks.score_rationale: China represents a significant portion of the company's sales (approximately 32% of consolidated sales in 2025). Weak macroeconomic conditions in China led to a significant sales decline in 2025, highlighting the company's vulnerability to fluctuations in the Chinese market.

risks.title: Internal Control Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company has implemented internal controls to prevent errors and fraud, but there remains a risk that these controls may be inadequate or improperly applied.

risks.title: Regulatory Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company is subject to strict regulations in the healthcare industry as a manufacturer of implantable intraocular lenses. Non-compliance could negatively impact operations.

risks.title: Litigation Risks
risks.score_rationale: The company may become involved in legal disputes with customers, suppliers, or competitors, which could negatively affect its reputation and financial condition.

ai_positioning.summary: The company STAA does not mention artificial intelligence, machine learning, or related technologies in its 10-K report. No information indicates involvement, strategy, or risks related to AI.
